# `oaap app convert`

turn a docker-compose file into an OAAP package draft.

**Root:** runs without `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap app convert [--out OUT] [--profile PROFILE] compose
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `compose` | -- |
| `--out OUT` | (default `./oaap-converted`) |
| `--profile PROFILE` | -- |
